purpose: the GE intent: the phrases that mean general education, and the pillar prefixes they map to

source.note: Nothing fetches the page. Pillar names are the NUS GE curriculum's (AY2021/22 on: GEA, GEC, GEI, GEN, GES/GESS, GEX) and the earlier pillars still offered (GEH, GEQ, GET); each prefix and its modules' titles were checked against the pinned corpus. A change to the curriculum means editing this file and rebuilding data/ge-pillars.json.

rules: a generic phrase maps to every prefix in `prefixes`; a pillar name maps to its own prefixes; several in one query take the union
matched at parse step 7, with the level phrases, on tokens no join consumed
interpreted.ge echoes the sorted prefixes; ignore=ge undoes it
a bare pillar prefix (`GEX`, `gess`) is a partial code (interpreted.prefix), not the GE intent
